exemptions.rationale: Hardware gate-level CPU timing proof (Busicom track) is not yet live. Backed by Level 3 WIR-level 2-safety self-composition trace proof and Level 5 equal-instruction-count microbenchmarks.

weaknesses.name: Use After Free
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; ownership and bounds checks prevent memory corruption

weaknesses.name: Out-of-bounds Write
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; ownership and bounds checks prevent memory corruption

weaknesses.name: Out-of-bounds Read
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; ownership and bounds checks prevent memory corruption

weaknesses.name: Double Free
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; ownership and bounds checks prevent memory corruption

weaknesses.name: NULL Pointer Dereference
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; ownership and bounds checks prevent memory corruption

weaknesses.name: Integer Overflow to Buffer Boundary
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; ownership and bounds checks prevent memory corruption

weaknesses.name: OS Command Injection
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no proc capability; analyzer verified zero process or shell execution

weaknesses.name: SQL Injection
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package contains no database interaction or SQL query construction

weaknesses.name: Path Traversal
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no fs capability; analyzer verified zero filesystem operations

weaknesses.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no ui capability and renders no HTML or DOM structures

weaknesses.name: Code Injection / Eval
weaknesses.reason: compiled Rust: language has no dynamic code evaluation or runtime eval primitives; analyzer verified no dynamic loading

weaknesses.name: Improper Output Encoding
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package performs no serialized protocol formatting with unescaped control delimiters

weaknesses.name: Log Injection
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no stdout or logging capabilities; analyzer verified zero log sinks

weaknesses.name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
weaknesses.reason: discharged: static zero-allocation proof verified; linear step bounds (steps <= c*n + d) proved via Warrant IR

weaknesses.name: Decompression Bomb
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package implements no decompression or archive decoding routines

weaknesses.name: Uncontrolled Recursion
weaknesses.reason: iterative algorithms: package contains zero recursive function calls; call graph is strictly acyclic

weaknesses.name: Inefficient Regular Expression (ReDoS)
weaknesses.reason: zero regular expressions: package contains no regular expression engines or pattern matching dependencies

weaknesses.name: Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity
weaknesses.reason: linear complexity: algorithms operate in strict linear time O(n) independent of input values

weaknesses.name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
weaknesses.reason: computed exemption (unapproved): floor requires proof to gate-level CPU netlist; backed by Level 3 WIR-level 2-safety self-composition trace proof and Level 5 equal-instruction-count microbenchmarks

weaknesses.name: Use of Insufficiently Random Values
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package performs purely deterministic computation and declares no rand capability

weaknesses.name: Use of Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
weaknesses.reason: primitive comparison: package implements constant-time comparison primitives rather than legacy ciphers

weaknesses.name: Inadequate Encryption Strength
weaknesses.reason: arbitrary buffer lengths: comparison functions accept arbitrary slice lengths without fixed sub-strength keys

weaknesses.name: Concurrent Execution Race Condition
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no thread capability and uses zero multithreading or shared mutable state

weaknesses.name: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package interacts with no external filesystem or process state

weaknesses.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package contains no dynamic object deserialization, polymorphic factories, or reflection

weaknesses.name: Prototype Pollution
weaknesses.reason: strongly typed language: Rust has no object prototypes or dynamic prototype inheritance chains
